title: Operations V3 Single-Door Control-Plane Reset
purpose: Replace overlapping governance and behavior surfaces with one GPT-first bootstrap, one operating contract, one current-state selector and one lane registry without losing product work or historical evidence.
scope: inventory every surface that can select work, grant authority, steer agent behavior, block/finalize execution, or present live current state
install operations/ as the canonical control plane
rewrite AIOC, application, GPT Project Source and executor entrypoints so they only redirect into the canonical door
classify remaining legacy surfaces as projection, validator, executor adapter, evidence, source reference or historical
prevent legacy application current-state prose from steering agents
separate executor availability from work authorization
preserve all completed product/code/content/source work and immutable evidence
validate contradictions and unauthorized live selectors fail closed
non_goals: repair the Windows Codex worker as a prerequisite for this migration
acceptance_criteria: AIOC has one canonical bootstrap at operations/BOOTSTRAP.md
AIOC has one canonical behavior contract at operations/OPERATING_CONTRACT.md
AIOC has one mutable current-state selector at operations/CURRENT.json
AIOC has one lane registry at operations/LANES.json
AIOC and application AGENTS.md contain redirects and no current/next-work claims
known legacy selectors and behavior policies are registered non-authoritative
application legacy current-state files no longer advertise STAGE-A-A2 or another live next task
GPT Project Source entry files are rewritten to the same door and replacement instructions are prepared for the Project settings surface
repository validation proves the single-door invariants
MIB-17 remains preserved selected_not_started with no implementation authority until the freeze is explicitly cleared

external_platform_actions.reason: The current tool surface does not expose a mutation API for Project custom instructions.
Project-backed source files can be read but not replaced in place through the available Project Files tool.

completion_rule: Do not clear the product freeze until repository cutover is merged/verified and the GPT Project entry surfaces have been replaced or explicitly recorded as the only remaining owner/platform action.
